recipes.name: Warm Lentil & Potato Salad
instructions: Heat the oil in a medium pot over medium-high heat . Cook the onion until lightly golden, about 3 to 5 minutes.
Add the remaining ingredients. Cook at a gentle simmer, partially covered, for 20 minutes. Stir occasionally.

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Soaking isn't necessary but helps to increase nutrient absorption and quickens cooking time.
Storage Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 4 days.
